description: This is a PHP test class for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for API endpoints related to employee leave entitlement management, including retrieving individual entitlements, validating request parameters, and fetching lists of entitlements. The class uses mock objects and extensive validation logic to ensure API correctness and proper authorization.
external_files: OrangeHRM\'s various service classes and DAOs
OrangeHRM Entities such as Employee, LeaveEntitlement, LeaveType
